name: Smart Model Router
description: Routes simple/cheap queries to a fast model and complex queries to the primary model, reducing cost and latency.

fastModel.description: Model to use for simple queries (e.g. 'gpt-5.4-mini')

simplePatterns.description: Regex patterns that identify simple queries

complexPatterns.description: Regex patterns that force the primary model

maxPromptLengthForFast.description: Prompts longer than this (chars) always use primary model (default: 800)

fastModel.label: Fast Model
fastModel.help: Model ID for simple/cheap queries (e.g. gpt-5.4-mini)

simplePatterns.label: Simple Query Patterns
simplePatterns.help: Regex patterns (case-insensitive) that identify simple queries routed to the fast model

complexPatterns.label: Complex Query Patterns
complexPatterns.help: Regex patterns (case-insensitive) that force use of the primary model

maxPromptLengthForFast.label: Max Prompt Length for Fast Model
